new_processes.name: Prior month adjustment review
new_processes.definition: Reviewing prior month adjustments and annuities from settlements before they are entered into a desk's month-end P&L.

new_processes.name: Hourly data mail-out
new_processes.definition: Sending regular hourly data files to internal customers as part of a daily mail-out.

new_processes.name: Analyst program candidate endorsement
new_processes.definition: Asking managers to endorse analysts and associates for a rotation program before interviews.

new_processes.name: Market data request
new_processes.definition: Customers asking Enron staff to gather historical gas price data for their analysis.

new_processes.name: Logistics presentation input
new_processes.definition: Collecting information from regional logistics staff to complete slides of a logistics presentation.

new_processes.name: Counterparty trading halt
new_processes.definition: Instructing the trading desk to stop trading with a counterparty.

new_processes.definition: Passing on packing and clean-up instructions to staff ahead of an office move.
